title: Leaving Brady: Golden Leaf band and Buddy Petit's music
summary: After Brady he joined the Golden Leaf band, then Buddy Petit wanted him; he kept Petit's orchestrations and had no teacher but Humphrey.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: And then after you worked for Senator Brady who did you play with?

Well after I worked for Senator Brady I believe the first band I got in was the Golden Leaf Band The Jesse Jackson And what did he play? Well he played ghetto, banjo you know, some banjo like Sam used to play there Well he used to get plenty jobs too cause John Robichaud used to give him jobs too And we'd always be playing alright And from that I was gone so I quit him and I got in somebody else band, let's see, I think Cause Buddy Petey wanted me I got some of his music right there now

No, an orchestra Augusta, yes I got plenty of it right there now in the drum So uh, and from that, well I was going then, then everybody was grabbing at me And then I started making it going and coming then
Did you have any other teacher on trombone except Jim Humphrey?
Professor Humphrey? No sir, no other one No other
